title: AI Code Generation Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. The AI Code Generation Engine is one of the 100 writing programs and tools AI should have: the actual programs, software tools, and engines — code editors, compilers, document creators, testing tools — that let an AI create real documents and working software. The key distinction this database honors: a description of a aI Code Generation Engine is not itself a aI Code Generation Engine. So this record carries the ACTUAL working implementation — real code, executed at build time, with verified outputs recorded below.
